text:
Hector Ruiz: idea 1: Moonlight Kayak + Pizza Paddle next Wed 7:30pm u2014 short paddle on the river, then pizza at the pier. chill, bring a jacket. :canoe: :pizza:
Nina Zhao: this sounds delightful. is it beginner-friendly? im a total novice. :sweat_smile:
Owen Brooks: totally beginner-friendly. kayaks are single & double, calm water. guide on site til 9pm.
Amira Khan: how much would this cost? and any waiver stuff?
Hector Ruiz: vendor quoted $22/person (kayak + lifejacket). pizza shared separately. they said waivers sign-on-arrival. i can cover the deposit and expense report later if ppl prefer social card.
Jules Park: opa! count me in. will there be parking?
Hector Ruiz: small lot near pier + street parking. we can carpool.
Nina Zhao: id join if we can pair me with a more confident paddler. happy to sign up for a double.
Owen Brooks: Ill paddle with @Nina. also happy to bring a thermos of hot chocolate.
Amira Khan: dietary note: vegan pizza options?
Jules Park: the pier place has a vegan margherita. i can confirm menu.
Hector Ruiz: created tiny RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/rw-kayak-pizza-rsvp u2014 please pick "single" or "double" and note dietary prefs.
Nina Zhao: done (double, vegan)
Owen Brooks: done (single)
Amira Khan: done (single, vegan)
LogisticsBot: Event pinned: "Moonlight Kayak & Pizza Paddle" Wed 7:30PM u2014 channel: #lunch-plans.
Hector Ruiz: quick checklist for people in case you want to copy:
```
- signed ID + waiver (vendor will have forms)
- waterproof jacket
- closed-toe shoes that can get wet
- headlamp or small flashlight
- $22 cash or Venmo for kayak (if not using social card)
- appetite for pizza
```
Jules Park: volunteer roles? i can handle pizza pick-up if someone sends final headcount + payment.
Hector Ruiz: volunteers: @Jules pizza pick-up, @Owen paddle buddy coordinator, @Amira will confirm vegan option. need one more person to handle carpool list.
Nina Zhao: i can do carpool list (happy to coordinate pickup spots).
Owen Brooks: weather contingency: vendor cancels if wind >15mph or heavy rain. we should have a backup plan u2014 movie night at the lounge? vote: 1) movie night backup 2) postponed to Thu 3) indoor arcade nearby
Jules Park: 1
Amira Khan: 2 (but fine with 1)
Hector Ruiz: leaning 1 for simplicity. if bad weather, movie night + pizza at the lounge.
LogisticsBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before event -> posting final headcount.
Hector Ruiz: final note u2014 bring a towel if you think you'll get wet. excited :) :crescent_moon:
